title: Blowhorn
registryDescription: Not a bot. It's you. Read-only hosted MCP, or local macOS server where changes are dry runs first.
shortDescription: Blowhorn isn't a bot. It's you, with your AI agent helping. Connect any MCP client to the hosted server at mcp.blowhorn.ai to read your connections, activity and content, or use the local server in the macOS desktop app, where AI drafts and you decide: every change is a dry run until you confirm it.
longDescription:
Blowhorn isn't a bot. It's you: social media automation that runs through your own profiles, on your own computers, under rules you set. The Blowhorn MCP servers bring your AI agent into that work without handing it the keys. AI drafts, you decide.

There are two ways to connect.

Hosted server: any MCP client can connect over the web at https://mcp.blowhorn.ai/mcp. You sign in with your Blowhorn account through OAuth, and clients register themselves, so there are no keys to copy or paste. It is read-only today, with four tools: getConnections, getEvents, getContentItem and listContentItems. Use it to give an agent one view of your whole social presence (your connections, your activity, and your content) from wherever it runs.

Local server: the Blowhorn desktop app for macOS includes a local stdio MCP server. It offers one tool per Blowhorn command, grouped into Act, Manage, Connect, Run, Observe and Meta, so an agent can draft, queue and check repeatable activities you control. You stay in command:
- Every tool that changes state runs as a dry run unless you confirm it.
- Approval mode applies to agents, so their work waits for a person to approve it.
- Riskier tools stay hidden until you opt in with --allow-hidden-tool.
- Results never include secrets, and tool arguments are never logged.
Requires Blowhorn 1.61.0 or later.

No Blowhorn server ever signs in or posts as you. Whatever goes out goes out from your own computer, as you.
